resources.string: Run Android commands as root through su. Disabled by default. Every command requires approval. Your device root manager also controls access; disabling this tool does not revoke its grant.

UID 0 verified. Root grants can change; verify again to refresh.

su did not grant UID 0. ADB or shell access alone is insufficient.
Verification timed out. Review access in your device root manager, then verify again.
